:::{#thm-deriv-dot-product}

#### Product rule for dot-products

If $\mathbf{a} = \mathbf{a}(\vx)$ and $\mathbf{b} = \mathbf{b}(\vx)$
are differentiable $p \times 1$ vector functions of $\vx$, then:

$$
\ba
\deriv{\ubf{\vx}{p \times 1}} \dpf{\ubf{a}{p \times 1}}{\ubf{b}{p \times 1}}
&=
\paren{
    \deriv{\ubf{\vx}{p \times 1}} \ubf{\tp{a}}{1 \times p}
  }
\ubf{b}{p \times 1}
+
\paren{
  \deriv{\ubf{\vx}{p \times 1}} \ubf{\tp{b}}{1 \times p}
}
\ubf{a}{p \times 1}
\ea
$$

:::
